product_one_liner.value: Leena AI provides global enterprises with AI Colleagues—digital workers that handle requests and automate complex back-office workflows.
product_one_liner.notes: The official documentation describes an enterprise Agentic AI platform for global organizations whose AI Colleagues are digital workers for automating back-office work.

pricing_page.notes: The official pricing URL provides pricing information and describes the pricing model and proposal calculator, so a public pricing page exists.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Two official Leena AI case studies explicitly identify Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages and Beacon Mobility as customers. | named_customers.0: The HCCB case study labels Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages as the customer. | named_customers.1: The case study labels Beacon Mobility as the customer.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn’s company profile reports 327 employees, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The official contact page lists the company’s New York, NY location and its New York street address. | hq_country: The official contact page lists the company’s New York, NY location and street address, establishing its U.S. headquarters location.

founded_year.notes: Leena AI’s official About page explicitly says it was founded in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: Leena AI’s blog includes a technical deep dive into its PDF parsing pipeline and its engineering team’s work, and a separate reproducible agent-benchmarking article written by its VP of Engineering. These are two product-building technical posts.

public_docs.notes: Leena AI has a public documentation site describing itself as a complete reference and linking to multiple guides and feature articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A Leena AI Engineering Manager - AI/ML posting on the B Capital job board is dated September 3, 2026 and still presents an Apply now action. The official Workable list last updated November 3 does not show that title, so the answer is based on the apparently live ML posting and carries some source-status uncertainty.

model_provider.value: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, and Amazon Bedrock are listed as configurable model providers.
model_provider.notes: The official model-configuration documentation lists OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, and Amazon Bedrock as providers for the Master Orchestrator model.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The official Trust & Security page names SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR among its certifications; the answer includes only the requested categories appearing there. | compliance_certs.0: The Trust & Security page names SOC 2 Type II. | compliance_certs.1: The Trust & Security page names ISO 27001. | compliance_certs.2: The Trust & Security page names HIPAA. | compliance_certs.3: The Trust & Security page names GDPR.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest dated funding announcement characterizes IBM Ventures’ October 2026 funding as a strategic investment. | funding_date: The dated announcement reports a strategic investment from IBM Ventures on October 20, 2026; the requested month is 2026-10.

raised_18mo.notes: The October 20, 2026 strategic investment occurred within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current Workable openings list includes two Enterprise Sales Development Representative roles and a Senior Account Executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Leena AI announced Leena Forge as live on October 14, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The captured profile identifies a current Leena AI VP role and a 2026 start date, placing a VP-level join within the 12-month window before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Leena AI’s sales-development job postings name Salesforce and HubSpot as CRM systems, and one identifies HubSpot as its CRM system. | crm_stack_signal.0: A Leena AI sales-development posting names Salesforce as CRM software. | crm_stack_signal.1: A Leena AI sales-development posting explicitly identifies HubSpot as its CRM system.
